title: desmodium racemosum
intro: Desmodium racemosum, commonly known as showy tick clover or pink tick clover, is a perennial legume native to North America. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions such as eczema and acne. The therapeutic actions of Desmodium racemosum include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, making it useful for wound healing and as an antiseptic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
